action_rules.scope: logical input intention only; no invented fields
explicit save intention; no HTTP claim
explicit completion-result inspection intention; no passive outcome accepted as direct evidence
post-input registration intention only; no endpoint or UI mechanism claim
action_rules.source_condition: procedure is exactly 등록, prior procedure explicitly inputs information, no later input procedure
standalone first screen/menu name without verb

action_rules.reason: registration initiation/form entry vs completed register action not specified
task termination vs popup close/navigation/other explicit operation not specified

readiness_policy: Any unresolved typed screen/action blocks full executable schema. Partial review is NOT an evaluation input.
screen_policy: Logical workflow names do not establish page_path/page_title/menu_path/popup_title. Require original explicit typed identifiers; never infer from generated or raw evidence.
target_policy: Preserve original label, step ID/order and aliases exactly. Do not strip object words or add output-compatible aliases.
